push.title: Notifications
push.description: Get a notification on this device when something happens with the orders.
push.enabled: Notifications are on for this device.
push.disabledToast: Notifications were turned off on this device.
push.unsupported: This browser can't receive push notifications. Use Chrome or Edge on a computer, or Chrome on Android. While the page is open you still get in-page alerts with sound.
push.notConfigured: Push notifications aren't set up on the server yet. While the page is open you get in-page alerts with sound.
push.deniedTitle: Notifications are blocked for this site
push.deniedText: The browser blocked notifications. Here's how to turn them back on:
push.deniedChrome: Chrome / Edge on a computer: click the icon left of the address (padlock or settings) → Notifications → Allow, then reload the page.
push.deniedFirefox: Firefox: click the icon left of the address → next to Notifications click “×” (clear the block), then reload the page and press the button again.
push.deniedAndroid: Chrome on Android: tap the three dots → Settings → Site settings → Notifications → pick this site → Allow. If you installed the app on the home screen: phone Settings → Apps → Home Menu → Notifications.
push.deniedFallback: Until then, while the page is open, you'll see in-page alerts with sound.
push.error: Notifications could not be turned on. Please try again.
push.promptTitle: Want to know the moment it's ready?
push.promptText: Turn on notifications and get a message even when the app is closed.
